svg.title: Predicate / נשוא
svg.desc: Chapter 3, Hebrew p21, English p22. What is affirmed or denied of a subject. The established violet statement tile is adapted to emphasize its right-hand arrow-shaped predicate cell and square term glyph. A smaller, lighter subject cell and circle preserve the relation. The arrow is the term-role carrier, not a separate inference, a causal process, or a timeline. Emphasis identifies the predicate, not truth, negation, uncertainty, scope, importance, or amount. The tile remains outlined; its solid internal glyph represents a term. This is a role within a statement, not a Chapter 9 discussion move or a kind of attribute.
